title: HiringActionRequest
description: The hiring-domain action contract. Carries candidate, role, level, compensation bounds, location, employment type, and decision/contract provenance. Translated by an adapter into the platform CER / shared ActionGate contract (see to_cer_payload). This package neither authorizes nor executes the action — that is the shared ActionGate + Runtime Assurance + HRIS, reached through ports. Tracks ugence_ai_hiring.hiring_decision.action_request.HiringActionRequest.

decision_id.description: The binding Employment Decision this action realizes.

$comment: to_cer_payload() emits { action_type: HIRING_OFFER, subject, action, provenance{contract_id,contract_version,ir_digest,decision_id,recommendation_id}, action_request_id } for the shared ActionGate / CER.
